data.patch:
--- a/Projects/dot-breakout/src/game.ts
+++ b/Projects/dot-breakout/src/game.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,328 @@
+export const W = 960
+export const H = 600
+
+export type Phase = 'title' | 'ready' | 'playing' | 'paused' | 'won' | 'lost'
+
+export interface Vec {
+  x: number
+  y: number
+}
+
+export interface Ball extends Vec {
+  vx: number
+  vy: number
+  r: number
+}
+
+export interface Paddle extends Vec {
+  w: number
+  h: number
+}
+
+export interface Brick extends Vec {
+  w: number
+  h: number
+  row: number
+  alive: boolean
+}
+
+export interface Input {
+  pointerX: number | null
+  left: boolean
+  right: boolean
+}
+
+export interface Snapshot {
+  phase: Phase
+  score: number
+  lives: number
+  remaining: number
+  ballX: number
+  ballY: number
+  paddleX: number
+}
+
+export interface Game {
+  phase: Phase
+  ball: Ball
+  paddle: Paddle
+  bricks: Brick[]
+  score: number
+  lives: number
+  remaining: number
+  look: Vec
+  flash: number
+}
+
+export const COLS = 10
+export const ROWS = 5
+export const START_LIVES = 3
+
+const BRICK_H = 28
+const BRICK_GAP = 6
+const BRICK_SIDE = 48
+const BRICK_TOP = 76
+
+const PADDLE_SPEED = 760
+const BALL_R = 8
+const BASE_SPEED = 350
+const SPEED_PER_BRICK = 6
+const MAX_SPEED = 640
+const MAX_BOUNCE_ANGLE = (60 * Math.PI) / 180
+
+export const BRICK_W = (W - BRICK_SIDE * 2 - BRICK_GAP * (COLS - 1)) / COLS
+
+export const ROW_COLORS = ['#ff5f7e', '#ffa651', '#ffe27a', '#5fe0a8', '#6cb8ff']
+
+export const PADDLE_Y = 546
+export const PADDLE_W = 132
+export const PADDLE_H = 14
+
+function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
+  return value < min ? min : value > max ? max : value
+}
+
+function brickScore(row: number): number {
+  return (ROWS - row) * 10
+}
+
+function makeBricks(): Brick[] {
+  const bricks: Brick[] = []
+  for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row++) {
+    for (let col = 0; col < COLS; col++) {
+      bricks.push({
+        x: BRICK_SIDE + col * (BRICK_W + BRICK_GAP),
+        y: BRICK_TOP + row * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP),
+        w: BRICK_W,
+        h: BRICK_H,
+        row,
+        alive: true,
+      })
+    }
+  }
+  return bricks
+}
+
+export function createGame(): Game {
+  const game: Game = {
+    phase: 'title',
+    ball: { x: W / 2, y: PADDLE_Y - BALL_R - 1, vx: 0, vy: 0, r: BALL_R },
+    paddle: { x: W / 2 - PADDLE_W / 2, y: PADDLE_Y, w: PADDLE_W, h: PADDLE_H },
+    bricks: makeBricks(),
+    score: 0,
+    lives: START_LIVES,
+    remaining: COLS * ROWS,
+    look: { x: 0, y: -1 },
+    flash: 0,
+  }
+  parkBall(game)
+  return game
+}
+
+function parkBall(game: Game): void {
+  const { ball, paddle } = game
+  ball.vx = 0
+  ball.vy = 0
+  ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2
+  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1
+  game.look.x = 0
+  game.look.y = -1
+}
+
+function speedFor(game: Game): number {
+  const destroyed = COLS * ROWS - game.remaining
+  return Math.min(MAX_SPEED, BASE_SPEED + destroyed * SPEED_PER_BRICK)
+}
+
+function rescale(game: Game): void {
+  const { ball } = game
+  const current = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy)
+  if (current === 0) return
+  const target = speedFor(game)
+  ball.vx = (ball.vx / current) * target
+  ball.vy = (ball.vy / current) * target
+}
+
+export function launch(game: Game): void {
+  if (game.phase !== 'title' && game.phase !== 'ready') return
+  const angle = (Math.random() - 0.5) * (Math.PI / 3)
+  const speed = speedFor(game)
+  game.ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed
+  game.ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * speed
+  game.phase = 'playing'
+}
+
+export function restart(game: Game): void {
+  game.phase = 'title'
+  game.bricks = makeBricks()
+  game.score = 0
+  game.lives = START_LIVES
+  game.remaining = COLS * ROWS
+  game.flash = 0
+  game.paddle.x = W / 2 - game.paddle.w / 2
+  parkBall(game)
+}
+
+export function togglePause(game: Game): void {
+  if (game.phase === 'playing') game.phase = 'paused'
+  else if (game.phase === 'paused') game.phase = 'playing'
+}
+
+export function update(game: Game, dt: number, input: Input): void {
+  if (game.flash > 0) game.flash = Math.max(0, game.flash - dt * 4)
+  smoothLook(game, dt)
+
+  if (game.phase === 'title' || game.phase === 'ready') {
+    movePaddle(game, dt, input)
+    parkBall(game)
+    return
+  }
+  if (game.phase !== 'playing') return
+
+  movePaddle(game, dt, input)
+
+  const { ball } = game
+  const travel = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) * dt
+  const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(travel / (ball.r * 0.5)))
+  const sdt = dt / steps
+  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
+    if (game.phase !== 'playing') break
+    substep(game, sdt)
+  }
+}
+
+function smoothLook(game: Game, dt: number): void {
+  const { ball, look } = game
+  const speed = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy)
+  let tx = look.x
+  let ty = look.y
+  if (speed > 1) {
+    tx = ball.vx / speed
+    ty = ball.vy / speed
+  } else if (game.phase === 'title' || game.phase === 'ready') {
+    tx = 0
+    ty = -1
+  }
+  const k = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 12)
+  look.x += (tx - look.x) * k
+  look.y += (ty - look.y) * k
+  const mag = Math.hypot(look.x, look.y) || 1
+  look.x /= mag
+  look.y /= mag
+}
+
+function movePaddle(game: Game, dt: number, input: Input): void {
+  const { paddle } = game
+  if (input.left !== input.right) {
+    paddle.x += (input.left ? -1 : 1) * PADDLE_SPEED * dt
+  } else if (input.pointerX !== null) {
+    paddle.x = input.pointerX - paddle.w / 2
+  }
+  paddle.x = clamp(paddle.x, 0, W - paddle.w)
+}
+
+function substep(game: Game, dt: number): void {
+  const { ball } = game
+  ball.x += ball.vx * dt
+  ball.y += ball.vy * dt
+
+  if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) {
+    ball.x = ball.r
+    ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx)
+  } else if (ball.x + ball.r > W) {
+    ball.x = W - ball.r
+    ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx)
+  }
+  if (ball.y - ball.r < 0) {
+    ball.y = ball.r
+    ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy)
+  }
+
+  if (ball.vy > 0 && hitsPaddle(game)) bounceOffPaddle(game)
+  hitBricks(game)
+
+  if (ball.y - ball.r > H) loseLife(game)
+}
+
+function hitsPaddle(game: Game): boolean {
+  const { ball, paddle } = game
+  if (ball.y >= paddle.y + paddle.h) return false
+  const cx = clamp(ball.x, paddle.x, paddle.x + paddle.w)
+  const cy = clamp(ball.y, paddle.y, paddle.y + paddle.h)
+  const dx = ball.x - cx
+  const dy = ball.y - cy
+  return dx * dx + dy * dy <= ball.r * ball.r
+}
+
+function bounceOffPaddle(game: Game): void {
+  const { ball, paddle } = game
+  const offset = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2)
+  const angle = clamp(offset, -1, 1) * MAX_BOUNCE_ANGLE
+  const speed = Math.max(Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy), speedFor(game))
+  ball.vx = Math.sin(angle) * speed
+  ball.vy = -Math.cos(angle) * speed
+  ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 0.5
+  game.flash = 1
+}
+
+function hitBricks(game: Game): void {
+  const { ball } = game
+  for (const brick of game.bricks) {
+    if (!brick.alive) continue
+    const cx = clamp(ball.x, brick.x, brick.x + brick.w)
+    const cy = clamp(ball.y, brick.y, brick.y + brick.h)
+    const dx = ball.x - cx
+    const dy = ball.y - cy
+    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > ball.r * ball.r) continue
+
+    const bx = brick.x + brick.w / 2
+    const by = brick.y + brick.h / 2
+    const overlapX = brick.w / 2 + ball.r - Math.abs(ball.x - bx)
+    const overlapY = brick.h / 2 + ball.r - Math.abs(ball.y - by)
+
+    if (overlapX < overlapY) {
+      ball.vx = ball.x < bx ? -Math.abs(ball.vx) : Math.abs(ball.vx)
+      ball.x += ball.x < bx ? -overlapX : overlapX
+    } else {
+      ball.vy = ball.y < by ? -Math.abs(ball.vy) : Math.abs(ball.vy)
+      ball.y += ball.y < by ? -overlapY : overlapY
+    }
+
+    brick.alive = false
+    game.remaining--
+    game.score += brickScore(brick.row)
+
+    if (game.remaining === 0) {
+      game.phase = 'won'
+      ball.vx = 0
+      ball.vy = 0
+      return
+    }
+    rescale(game)
+    return
+  }
+}
+
+function loseLife(game: Game): void {
+  game.lives--
+  if (game.lives > 0) {
+    game.phase = 'ready'
+    parkBall(game)
+    return
+  }
+  game.phase = 'lost'
+  game.ball.vx = 0
+  game.ball.vy = 0
+}
+
+export function snapshot(game: Game): Snapshot {
+  return {
+    phase: game.phase,
+    score: game.score,
+    lives: game.lives,
+    remaining: game.remaining,
+    ballX: game.ball.x,
+    ballY: game.ball.y,
+    paddleX: game.paddle.x,
+  }
+}
